# OpsIdea

> OpsIdea is a technology initiative focused on exploring ideas, building developer tools, experimenting with AI, and automating everyday engineering workflows.

OpsIdea explores the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, and intelligent automation to build practical technology solutions.

## Focus areas

- Cloud Engineering — cloud infrastructure, scalable architectures, and infrastructure automation.
- DevOps & Platform Engineering — CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, GitOps, and reliable software delivery.
- AI Engineering — AI applications, LLM integrations, intelligent agents, and practical AI tools.
- Intelligent Automation — workflow automation, API integrations, and AI-powered automation experiments.
